summary: DMC Global Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 2 to its Stockholder Protection Rights Agreement (poison pill), extending the expiration from June 4, 2026 to June 4, 2027. No financial terms, premium, or change in ownership triggers are altered; the 10% (20% for passive investors) beneficial ownership threshold remains. The amendment is a routine extension without new activism or transaction. This filing does not constitute a special situation as it merely updates a defensive measure without an underlying acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event.
